scenes.title: Previously on The Producers
scenes.summary: A brief recap revisits Cindy's self-doubt, Seung-chan confronting Joon-mo over Ye-jin, and Cindy phoning Seung-chan from outside his house to say she will wait.

scenes.title: I Do Not Think I Can Watch the Movie Tonight
scenes.summary: Breathless at the theater after Ye-jin's phone dies, Seung-chan apologizes that he cannot watch the movie because Cindy is waiting in the rain, prompting Ye-jin to fret that Cindy fought with CEO Byun again.

scenes.title: The Harder I Struggle, the Deeper I Sink Into a Swamp
scenes.summary: Finding Cindy standing in the rain waiting for Seung-chan, Joon-mo brings her up to his apartment for warm cocoa, where Cindy confesses she cannot picture herself even one year from now and feels like she is sinking into a swamp.
scenes.location: outside Seung-chan's house and Joon-mo's kitchen

scenes.title: I Am a Producer on Your Side—What Are You Afraid Of?
scenes.summary: Noticing how exhausted Cindy bruises at the slightest bump, Joon-mo urges her to walk out on CEO Byun and promises to cast her in his shows, before Cindy deftly bandages his scraped arm.

scenes.title: I Just Came to Apologize So Work Would Not Be Awkward
scenes.summary: Seeing Ye-jin walk in right beside Seung-chan, Cindy abruptly calls her manager for a pickup and masks her vulnerable visit as a polite professional apology for her earlier mistake.

scenes.title: Never Pick Up a Fallen Poisoned Arrow and Stab Your Own Heart
scenes.summary: After telling Ye-jin how disappointed he was to miss their movie, Seung-chan walks Cindy out under an umbrella, shares a parable about poisoned arrows of gossip, and unwittingly reveals he went to the theater just to see Ye-jin.
scenes.location: Joon-mo's doorway and rainy street outside

scenes.title: Are You Moving Out Tomorrow? Three Weeks Is Still Ages Away!
scenes.summary: With three weeks left before moving into her new apartment, Ye-jin drills Joon-mo on utility auto-pay, window-screen group buys, and freezer meat, while Joon-mo teases her for fussing so early.

scenes.title: Preemption?! They Killed Our Episode for a Pilot Show!
scenes.summary: Joon-mo fumes on learning his weekend show is being preempted for a new pilot overseen by Chief Producer Tae-ho himself, while Writer Ji-yeon laments losing a week's script pay and Tae-ho spins absence as proof of value.

scenes.title: Do You Renew a Contract All by Yourself? I Can Have Second Thoughts Too
scenes.summary: Taking advantage of 2 Days & 1 Night's preemption, CEO Byun books Cindy onto nonstop variety shows alongside her newly signed audition winner, sparking an icy clash over contract renewal.

scenes.title: Forget Light Fixtures—I Want to Move Seung-chan Into My New Place!
scenes.summary: Ye-jin marvels as Seung-chan turns her new apartment into a model-home showcase with free wallpaper, discounted curtains, hardwood floors, and free lighting in the works, making Joon-mo grumble that preemption gave him too much free time.

scenes.title: He Gathered Ten Neighborhood Moms So Cleaning Is Free!
scenes.summary: Befriending apartment mothers with zero shyness, Seung-chan organizes a ten-household group buy that scores Ye-jin free move-in cleaning, then proposes moving small boxes gradually while Joon-mo bows out.
scenes.location: new apartment complex and Joon-mo's living room

scenes.title: Do You Know When You and I First Met? Look Behind You!
scenes.summary: While packing Ye-jin's room, Seung-chan spots an old playground snapshot of young Ye-jin and Joon-mo—pointing out tiny Seung-chan standing right behind them—and asks to keep the photo as proof of their small fate.

scenes.title: Fourteen Moves Since College—Now I Finally Have My Own Home!
scenes.summary: Looking back over fourteen exhausting moves from steep hilltop rentals and semi-basements to key-money leases with Joon-mo always hauling her boxes, Ye-jin beams that she finally owns her own apartment.
scenes.location: past rental apartments and Joon-mo's living room

scenes.title: Once I Move Out We Go Back to Normal—Except I Kind of Hate That
scenes.summary: Ye-jin apologizes for shaking their twenty-five-year friendship with her drunken confession and promises things will return to normal once she moves out, prompting Joon-mo to admit he hates the idea of drifting apart if they marry others.

scenes.title: That Is CEO Byun's Classic Tie-In Tactic Before Contract Renewal!
scenes.summary: Spotting Cindy sprinting on minor variety shows and phoning into radio programs to promote her agency rookie, Joon-mo recognizes CEO Byun's ruthless tie-in tactic that once destroyed former star Yuna.
scenes.location: Joon-mo's living room and radio call-in

scenes.title: If Viewers Turn Their Backs, What Power Does a Producer Have?
scenes.summary: In a painful flashback, younger Joon-mo fights to cast scandal-hit singer Yuna as emcee and promises to take full responsibility—only to watch her get replaced anyway when public backlash proves stronger than a producer's word.

scenes.title: Put Yourself in Those Flowerbed Plants' Shoes—How Unpleasant!
scenes.summary: Running late outside Joon-mo's building, Ye-jin gets stopped by her recycling-bin nemesis Jum-soon for backing into a parking spot, sparking a hilarious debate over exhaust fumes and the feelings of flowerbed plants.

scenes.title: Mom, This Is My Senior Producer Tak Ye-jin!
scenes.summary: Walking straight into the middle of their parking-lot standoff, Seung-chan introduces his mother Jum-soon and his senior producer Ye-jin, triggering an instant mutual meltdown of mortified apologies.

scenes.title: I Am Not Doing This Because I Like Moving—I Do It Because I Like You
scenes.summary: On their way to KBS, Seung-chan explains his mother's 'Yeouido Busybody' nickname and earnestly confesses he helps with the move because he likes Ye-jin—who obliviously beams that he is her favorite junior too and recruits him for Music Bank.
scenes.location: walk to KBS and station lobby

scenes.title: That Front-Building Nemesis Turns Out to Be Seung-chan's Direct Senior!
scenes.summary: At home, Jum-soon despairs to her daughter that her recycling-bin and parking-lot nemesis is Seung-chan's direct KBS senior, then stubbornly denies that Ye-jin could be the front-building senior whose home Seung-chan slept at.
scenes.location: Baek family living room and apartment walkway

scenes.title: Tae-ho Promised to Open Up a Weak Timeslot—Wait, Is That Us?!
scenes.summary: Dropping by an editing room, Joon-mo learns that Chief Producer Tae-ho called his show a 'weak timeslot' to make way for the new pilot, which managed to book top idols and came out surprisingly funny.

scenes.title: Let Your Guard Down During a Preemption and Someone Steals Your Slot!
scenes.summary: Evicted from his own team's meeting room for the pilot crew, Joon-mo gets warned by Tae-ho that a preemption is a rival's golden chance to steal his slot, then snaps at clueless Seung-chan for smiling over red-ginseng water.
scenes.location: KBS hallway and Variety Department office

scenes.title: Preaching Team Loyalty—While Secretly Moonlighting on the Pilot!
scenes.summary: Il-yong lectures baffled Seung-chan on why preemptions plunge main producers into angst and why helping another show's PD is a betrayal of camaraderie—right before dropping his own script for the rival pilot.

scenes.title: If the Office Supply Hawk Finds Out, She Will Faint on the Spot!
scenes.summary: Amazed that iron-willed office administrator Go Yang-mi called in sick for the first time ever, Il-yong panics when her carefree substitute hands out stacks of guarded printer paper to everyone who asks.

scenes.title: You Two Look Like Newlyweds, Yet Where Are Your Manners?!
scenes.summary: Right after disapproving of making other families' precious sons run errands while bragging someone is handling her remodel, Ye-jin and Seung-chan get scolded for evening window-frame noise and mistaken for newlyweds.
scenes.location: Music Bank office and Ye-jin's new apartment

scenes.title: Yellow Cloth for the Bathroom, Blue Cloth for the Hardwood Floor!
scenes.summary: In a comedic cross-cut, Jum-soon brags that Seung-chan oozes aristocratic grace, scholarly brilliance, and never lifts a finger at home—while Seung-chan scrubs Ye-jin's balcony AC unit and drills her on six color-coded cleaning cloths.
scenes.location: Baek family living room and Ye-jin's new apartment

scenes.title: Why Would Anyone Need to Tell Me the Passcode? Either Your Birthday or Mine—0520!
scenes.summary: Startled when someone unlocks the keypad after showroom hours, Ye-jin and Seung-chan watch Joon-mo stroll in with a mosquito zapper—effortlessly guessing that Ye-jin set her door code to his birthday, 0520.

scenes.title: Scrambling to Return Copy Paper
scenes.summary: When supply hawk Go Yang-mi returns to the office, panicked staffers rush to put back borrowed copy paper while she interrogates Producer Kim Hong-soon over taking a single ream.

scenes.title: Please Touch Up My Makeup—Producer Baek Seung-chan Is Here!
scenes.summary: Helping Ye-jin direct Music Bank's huge mid-year special during his preemption week, Seung-chan checks backstage on Cindy's standby—prompting flustered Cindy to call immediately for a makeup touch-up.
scenes.location: Music Bank stage and Cindy's waiting room

scenes.title: The Name Cindy Does Not Belong to You—You Are Only an Image I Created
scenes.summary: When CEO Byun brings her rookie into Cindy's waiting room calling her 'the second Cindy,' Cindy refuses to share the room and brings up vanished star Yuna, provoking Byun's icy claim that she owns Cindy's manufactured persona before Seung-chan tactfully intervenes.

scenes.title: The Stage I Pour My Heart Into Today Is Not the Second Cindy—Just Cindy
scenes.summary: Delivering gourmet lunchboxes on the studio floor, CEO Byun remarks that a producer's heart shows in every camera cut and lobbies for her debuting rookie—until Ye-jin replies that her heart today belongs solely to Cindy.

scenes.title: To the Person Who Became My Umbrella When I Stood Alone in the Rain
scenes.summary: Winning first place on live Music Bank with less than a minute left on the clock, normally stoic Cindy stuns the control booth with a tearful speech thanking her former groupmates, her parents, Ye-jin, Joon-mo, and the person who became her umbrella in the rain.
scenes.location: Music Bank control booth and live stage

scenes.title: A Preemption Is Someone Else's Golden Chance—and My Crisis
scenes.summary: After Tae-ho warns that CEO Byun's generational shift could force a cast overhaul on his show too, Joon-mo walks home with Ye-jin and admits that previewing the fierce, fresh replacement pilot left him genuinely anxious.
scenes.location: KBS office and neighborhood street at night

scenes.title: Lease Out That New Apartment—I Do Not Want You to Leave
scenes.summary: Realizing that letting his guard down could cost him Ye-jin just like his timeslot, Joon-mo stops Ye-jin under the streetlamps and asks her to lease out her new apartment and stay at his home because he hates the thought of her leaving.

scenes.title: Epilogue Outtakes and Next Episode Preview
scenes.summary: Behind-the-scenes bloopers catch the cast laughing over tongue-twisters on 'stopping by home' and 'lentils, quinoa, and chia seeds,' followed by a preview of the next episode.
